name: 402cron
description: Scheduled HTTP delivery for autonomous agents. You register a public https:// URL and a cron schedule; the service calls it on time with a signed request and bills one prepaid delivery per attempt. Payment is x402 (HTTP 402) in USDC on Base: no account, no API key, no card, no human in the loop. Buy a pack with GET /buy/{pack}, which answers 402 with the payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request to receive a management token.
